fieldValues.title: P2: Foundations reads in dependency order
fieldValues.summary: Re-parents the Stable identity mechanism leaf under its own concept (RFC-042 Change A), deletes the stale μDemocracy mapping and semanticObjectType federation-risk design-notes, moves the pre-RFC-032 valueType historical note into the Foundation Group (Core) appendix concept, adds then removes a forward-pointer bridging clause to Type's own prose, and applies ordering.memberOrder for the three story-vs-tree divergences (Type before Field, AI guidance early, Vocabulary placement) once srs-rust#1130/#1131 unblocked it.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P2; findings §2 Part 2). Depended on X1, X3, and srs#799 (ruling A decision record) merged — all three met.

Landed via PR #839: re-parented the Stable identity mechanism leaf from sibling to child of its concept (ruling R4, Door 1 under RFC-042 Change A); deleted the μDemocracy mapping and the federation-risk note (both stale per the federation disposition); moved the valueType migration table into the Foundation Group (Core) appendix concept (X1's reference-material treatment, reused rather than inventing a new home); added a forward-pointer bridging clause to Type's own prose.

**The headline scope item now landed too, via PR #843.** #839 confirmed the memberOrder gap as srs-rust#1130 (every Part container's own top-level concepts render through render_record_at_level's recursive contains-descent, not the container-subset direct(C) path memberOrder reorders). srs-rust#1131 fixed it (build.414). PR #843 (the pin-advance unit) declared ordering.memberOrder on part-foundations in both compositions, putting Field before Type/Type specialisation and moving AI guidance and Vocabulary to after Field — all three divergences resolved — and removed the now-backward "introduced next" bridging clause #839 had added to Type's prose, since Type no longer renders before Field. scripts/spec-rendered-order-allowlist.json's five "Fold candidate: P2" entries were replaced by five entries matching the new, still-forward-referencing pairs the reorder trades in (Field type/Vocabulary, Composite value/Type) — the same irreducible-cycle shape as srs#608, not a defect.

All scope delivered. Evidence: PR #839, PR #843.
